rv.q: Strawdog's production is adept enough to warrant them taking a chance on the next chapter.

Advance Man keeps us guessing and engaged as we have no idea what is going to happen next, but we’re locked into the intensity of both the family dynamics and the work happening to supposedly save humanity.
At the end of the day, this is a play that will have audiences split.

cn.t: This sci-fi puzzle play about Mars mission survivors intrigues genre fans with its slow-burn reveals and modern themes, though its world-building and script leave some audiences confused in this uneven trilogy opener.
